verses.literal: A song of ascents Out of the depths I cry to You O LORD

verses.original: אֲדֹנָי֮ שִׁמְעָ֪ה בְק֫וֹלִ֥י תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה אָ֭זְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁב֑וֹת לְ֝ק֗וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy šim·‘āh ḇə·qō·w·lî tih·ye·nāh ’ā·zə·ne·ḵā qaš·šu·ḇō·wṯ lə·qō·wl ta·ḥă·nū·nāy
verses.literal: O Lord hear my voice let Your ears be attentive . . . to my plea for mercy

verses.original: אִם־ עֲוֺנ֥וֹת תִּשְׁמָר־ יָ֑הּ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י מִ֣י יַעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.literal: If You O LORD kept track of iniquities then who O Lord could stand
But with You there is forgiveness so that You may be feared

verses.original: קִוִּ֣יתִי יְ֭הוָה קִוְּתָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י וְֽלִדְבָר֥וֹ הוֹחָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: qiw·wî·ṯî Yah·weh qiw·wə·ṯāh nap̄·šî wə·liḏ·ḇā·rōw hō·w·ḥā·lə·tî
verses.literal: I wait for the LORD my soul does wait and in His word I put my hope

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֥י לַֽאדֹנָ֑י מִשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים לַ֝בֹּ֗קֶר שֹׁמְרִ֥ים לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šî la·ḏō·nāy miš·šō·mə·rîm lab·bō·qer šō·mə·rîm lab·bō·qer
verses.literal: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning more than watchmen wait for the morning

verses.original: יַחֵ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶל־ יְה֫וָה כִּֽי־ עִם־ יְהוָ֥ה הַחֶ֑סֶד וְהַרְבֵּ֖ה עִמּ֣וֹ פְדֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: ya·ḥêl yiś·rā·’êl ’el- Yah·weh kî- ‘im- Yah·weh ha·ḥe·seḏ wə·har·bêh ‘im·mōw p̄ə·ḏūṯ
verses.literal: O Israel put your hope in the LORD for with the LORD is loving devotion and with Him is redemption in abundance

verses.original: וְ֭הוּא יִפְדֶּ֣ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל עֲוֺנֹתָֽיו׃
verses.literal: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity
